application.title: Apply for your lease
application.intro: Tell us about the applicant. We will check the eligibility rules for all items in your cart.
application.notice: This checks your answers against sample eligibility rules. It does not sign a contract, reserve an item or take payment.
application.changed: Your cart is empty, unavailable or has changed. Review it before applying.
application.expired: This quote is from an earlier day. Apply again for current prices and eligibility.
application.login: Please sign in to submit your application.
application.incomplete: Please complete all applicable questions with valid answers.
application.error: We could not submit your application. Please try again.
application.status.manual_review: A person needs to review your application
application.outcome.approved: Good news: your application meets our requirements for the items in your cart.
application.outcome.rejected: Thank you for applying. Based on your answers, we can't offer this lease. You'll find the reason below and what you can do next.
application.outcome.manual_review: Thanks for applying. A member of our team needs to look at your application before you can continue. Nothing has been signed, and you won't be charged.
application.reason.under_age: Leasing is available from age 18, so we can't approve this application yet. We'd be glad to hear from you again then.
application.underAge.title: Not just yet
application.underAge.why: Leasing means signing a contract: a promise to pay every month for a set time. The law says you have to be 18 to make that kind of promise on your own. It's the same rule for everyone, and it isn't about you.
application.underAge.when: You're welcome to apply yourself from {date}.
application.underAge.whenUnknown: You're welcome to apply yourself once you turn 18.
application.underAge.guardian: A parent or a trusted guardian can lease it in their own name and let you use it. They would apply themselves, sign the contract and be responsible for the monthly payments, so it's a good idea to talk it through together first.
application.underAge.email: Email this to a parent or guardian
application.underAge.emailSubject: Could you help me lease this?
application.reason.residency: For now, we can only offer leases to people living in Finland, Sweden or Estonia.
application.reason.affordability: The monthly payment would be more than 30% of your monthly income after tax. We keep to this limit so payments stay manageable. A less expensive item, a longer term or a down payment could bring it within reach.
application.reason.business_id: The business ID doesn't seem right: its last digit doesn't match the rest. Please check it and try again.
application.reason.financed_limits: The amount to finance is outside what we can lease (€300 to €250,000 in total). Changing the down payment or the items in your cart can help.
application.reason.pep: Because someone involved holds a prominent public position, a member of our team reviews the application. This is a standard legal check.
application.reason.signatory: The contract must be signed by someone with the right to sign for the company, so a member of our team will check the application first.
application.reason.large_amount: For financing of €50,000 or more, a member of our team always reviews the application.
application.reason.income_check: The question flow did not collect income for this amount, so a person must check affordability.
application.reason.income_not_required: Income isn't asked for this amount, so no affordability check was needed.
application.reason.incomplete: Some answers are missing or need another look.
application.reason.blocked_answer: Based on one of your answers, we can't offer this lease.
application.why.q_customer_type: Determines which questions and eligibility rules apply.
application.why.q_birth_date: Checks that you are at least 18 on the lease start date.
application.why.q_email: Provides a contact address for the application.
application.why.q_country: Leasing is available to residents of Finland, Sweden and Estonia.
application.why.q_employment: Helps assess whether rent fits your budget.
application.why.q_monthly_income: Combined monthly rent including VAT may be at most 30% of net income.
application.why.q_business_id: Checks the Finnish business ID format and check digit; it does not verify registry status.
application.why.q_company_name: Identifies the company applying for the lease.
application.why.q_can_sign: A company contract needs an authorized signatory.
application.why.q_signatory_email: Identifies a contact who is authorized to sign; this form does not send a contract.
application.why.q_usage_purpose: Helps explain how the e-bike will be used.
application.why.q_farm_registry: Identifies the farm or contractor applying for machinery.
application.why.q_annual_revenue: Financing of €50,000 or more requires business due diligence.
application.why.q_beneficial_owners: Identifies owners for review of higher-value applications.
application.why.q_pep: Politically exposed applicants or owners require manual review.
application.why.q_pep_details: Provides context for the required manual review.

inspection.reported: The customer reported a problem here
inspection.damageHint: Log damage outside normal use. Only new damage is charged to the customer, and they will see where it is and what it costs.
inspection.hint.serial_match: Compare the number on the item with the contract.
inspection.hint.accessories_complete: Everything supplied with the lease came back.
inspection.hint.service_records: Records are present and up to date for the item's usage.
inspection.hint.frame_fork: Head tube, welds, rear triangle and mounts. Look for cracks, bends and stress lines in the paint.
inspection.hint.brakes: Levers feel firm. Check pad wear, rotors and hydraulic lines for leaks.
inspection.hint.battery_pack: No swelling, cracks, impact marks, corroded contacts or signs of water.
inspection.hint.wheels: Spin each wheel: no wobble, loose spokes or flat spots.
inspection.hint.tyres: Tread depth, cuts and sidewall damage.
inspection.hint.drivetrain: Chain and cassette wear. No skipping under load.
inspection.hint.motor_assist: Ride at every assist level. No grinding, harsh engagement or power cuts.
inspection.hint.display_controls: Powers on cleanly, with no error codes or flickering.
inspection.hint.charging: Charges normally with the correct charger, which fits without force.
inspection.hint.chassis_hinges: Cracks or bends in the case and lid. Hinges hold the screen without play.
inspection.hint.power_on: Starts normally and reaches the operating system.
inspection.hint.display: Cracks, lines, dead pixels and even brightness.
inspection.hint.trackpad: Tracking and clicks work across the surface.
inspection.hint.ports: Every port works and none is loose.
inspection.hint.storage: The health report shows no errors.
inspection.hint.chassis_hitch: Frame, welds and the lower links of the three-point hitch.
inspection.hint.rops_seatbelt: The certified roll-over structure is undamaged and the seat belt works.
inspection.hint.pto_guard: The master shield is present and intact.
inspection.hint.brakes_steering: Brakes, parking brake and steering free play.
inspection.hint.engine: Starts easily from cold and runs well hot. Under load, listen for noise and watch the exhaust smoke.
inspection.hint.fluids: Levels and condition. Milky oil means water has got in; rusty coolant or wet fuel are warnings too.
inspection.hint.hydraulics: Hoses, cylinders and seals under pressure. A freshly washed machine can hide a slow leak.
inspection.hint.transmission_clutch: Oil level and condition. All gears engage under load without noise or slipping.
inspection.hint.pto_operation: Engage at each speed and listen for noise.
inspection.hint.electrics_lights: Battery, wiring and lights. Look for corrosion and worn wires.

application.reason.signatory_pending: Because you can't sign for the company, the contract will wait for {email} to sign it. When you continue, we lock the price and reserve the item. Nothing becomes active or is charged until they sign.
signing.waitingBody: The price is locked and the item is reserved. The contract becomes active on the day {email} signs, and billing starts then. Nothing is charged before that.
signing.emailBody:
Hi,

I've prepared a lease for {company}: {item}, {months}, {monthly} a month excluding VAT. I'm not allowed to sign contracts for the company, so I named you as the person who can.

Please review and sign it here:
{link}

Thank you!
signing.intro: {company} has asked you to sign this lease contract as someone with the right to sign for the company.
signing.startsOn: Billing starts on the day you sign.
signing.confirm: I have the right to sign contracts for {company}.
signing.signed: Signed on {date}. The contract is now active.
signing.invalid: This signing link isn't valid. Please ask the person who sent it for a new one.
signing.error: Signing didn't work. Please try again.
priceLock.title: The price changed since your quote
priceLock.body: You were quoted on {date}. Prices have changed since then, and signing locks the price that's valid today, so please check the new amounts.
priceLock.item: Quoted {quoted} (price list v{quotedVersion}), today {price} (price list v{version}).
priceLock.lower: Good news: the item is {amount} cheaper.
priceLock.accept: I accept today's price. Signing locks it for the whole lease.
priceLock.locked: Price locked from price list v{version}. Later price lists don't change it.
priceLock.quoted: You were quoted {quoted} (price list v{quotedVersion}) on {quotedDate}; signing locked {price} from the price list valid that day.
passport.label: Item passport
passport.title: {count} lives so far
passport.saved: By being used again instead of replaced, it has avoided about {kg} kg CO₂e so far.
passport.beforeRecords: Before our records: we know this life happened, not its dates.
passport.method: How we estimate it: making a new one emits about {newKg} kg CO₂e and refurbishing costs {share} % of that, so each life after the first avoids the rest, scaled by its condition at the start of that life (good 90 %, fair 70 %, poor 40 %). Factors are indicative.
secondLife.label: Second life
secondLife.title: Refurbish, and who gets it next
secondLife.refurbish.worth_it: Refurbish: yes. After the work it's worth {price} excl. VAT and the work costs {cost}, so refurbishing comes out {net} ahead.
secondLife.refurbish.costs_more_than_val: Refurbish: no. The work ({cost}) costs at least as much as the item would then be worth ({price}). Retire it instead.
secondLife.refurbish.not_leasable: Refurbish: no. At {price} it falls outside our financing table, so nobody could lease it.
secondLife.winner: {id} gets it ({who}): {months} at {rent} a month excl. VAT.
secondLife.decidedBy.only_match: They're the only person on the waiting list it suits.
secondLife.decidedBy.earliest_deadline: Others qualify too, but they need it soonest (by {date}).
secondLife.decidedBy.earliest_signup: Others need it by the same date ({date}); they signed up first.
secondLife.noMatch: Nobody on the waiting list suits it right now. Publish it to the catalogue.
secondLife.listIntro: The waiting list for a {condition} item at {price} excl. VAT, best match first:
secondLife.terms: Signed up #{signup} · {months} at {rent}, budget {budget} · needs {condition} or better by {date}
secondLife.rule: How we choose: someone qualifies if the condition, their deadline and the rent at their preferred term (excl. VAT) all fit. The earliest needed-by date wins; on the same date, whoever signed up first wins.
vatChange.note: VAT goes from {from} % to {to} %, so the monthly payment changes by {difference}. Your net rent stays {net}: only the tax changed.
vatChange.fictional: The {to} % rate is fictional, made up for this hackathon.
termEnded.title: Your lease ended on {date}
termEnded.body: What happens to the {item} now is up to you. You can buy it for {amount} including VAT, the price agreed in your contract, or return it to us.
termEnded.noBilling: There's no more monthly rent. Until you choose, the item stays with you.
audit.title: Audit trail
audit.intro: Who changed what, and when. Every change to business data (signing, invoices, payments, returns, staff decisions, demo actions) writes one entry in the same transaction as the change. The newest {count}, newest first.
dashboard.overdueNote: {amount} of this is already invoiced and unpaid.
agreement.title: Lease agreement summary
agreement.down: Down payment, paid at the start
agreement.total: Total if kept to the end
agreement.endPrice: Optional price to keep the item at the end
agreement.note: All amounts include VAT. The total is your down payment plus every monthly payment. It does not include the optional price at the end. If the VAT rate changes, your rent stays the same before VAT.
flow.endPriceNote: The end-of-lease price is the part of the item your monthly payments do not cover, agreed when you signed.

flow.part.service_due.working: Service up to date, controls work

flow.calc.title: How your amount is worked out
flow.calc.note: Includes VAT and uses your answers above. Percentages are rounded here, so working it by hand can differ slightly. Unpaid rent only counts for today's month.
flow.part.cooling_fault.minor: Gets hot, or the fan is loud
flow.part.cooling_fault.fault: Shuts down from heat, or the fan has stopped
flow.part.speed_fault.minor: Very slow to start or use
flow.part.camera_audio_fault.minor: One of them does not work
flow.part.hinge_fault.working: Firm, the lid stays where you put it
flow.part.hinge_fault.fault: Broken, the lid will not stay up
flow.part.liquid_fault.fault: Yes, something was spilled on it
return.issue.cooling_fault: Overheats or the fan is loud
return.issue.camera_audio_fault: Camera or speakers do not work
inspection.hint.cooling: Fan spins and is quiet under load. No overheating or shutdowns.
inspection.customerPaysRepair: New damage: the customer pays their share
inspection.battery.fine: Battery is fine. No replacement needed.
inspection.battery.normal: Replace it, but this is normal after {months} months, so the customer should not pay.
inspection.battery.charge: Replace it. This is low for {months} months, so the customer pays their share.
flow.calc.totalRule: You pay = ending early + your share of repairs + unpaid rent
flow.calc.endingRule: Ending early = what you still owe − what the item is worth to us
flow.calc.owedRule: What you still owe = payments left × monthly payment + end-of-lease price − interest saved by paying now
flow.calc.worthRule: What it is worth = original price × age × condition after repair × use − work every return needs (like the data wipe)
flow.calc.repairsRule: Your share of repairs = all repairs × your share
flow.calc.shareRule: Your share = 50 % + 50 % × months left ÷ months in the lease
flow.buyoutRule: To buy today = everything left to pay − interest saved by paying now + unpaid rent
flow.buyoutSaved: Interest saved by paying now ({rate} % a year)
relist.formula: {age} % for age × {condition} % for condition × {usage} % for use
recovery.agreedPrice: Customer pays, as agreed in the return form
inspection.damageHintAgreed: Log damage outside normal use. This records our work; the customer's price does not change.
inspection.battery.agreed: Replace it. The customer's price stays as agreed.

review.title: Applications to review
review.intro: These applications need a person: for example a large amount or a politically exposed person. Read the reasons, write a short note and approve or reject. The customer sees the result on their application page and, once approved, can continue to signing.
review.note: Your note (required, saved in the audit trail)
review.error: That didn't work. Refresh the page and try again.
review.empty: No applications are waiting for review.
application.outcome.awaiting_signatory: Your application meets our requirements, but you can't sign for the company. Nothing is approved for the company until {email} signs. When you continue, we lock the price and reserve the item, and give you a personal signing link to send them. The contract only becomes active, and nothing is charged, once they sign.
